CREATE TABLE "public"."emailVerificationToken" (
  "consumedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."expense" (
  "baseAmountMinor" int8 NOT NULL,
  "baseCurrency" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdByMemberId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "exchangeRateDenominator" text,
  "exchangeRateNumerator" text,
  "exchangeRateProvider" text,
  "exchangeRateQuotedAt" timestamptz,
  "groupId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "originalAmountMinor" int8 NOT NULL,
  "originalCurrency" text NOT NULL,
  "paidByMemberId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."expenseGroup" (
  "baseCurrency" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdByIdentityId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "expenseGroup_status_check_91fcbd87" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."expenseGroupInvitation" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expenseGroupId" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "inviteeId" text NOT NULL,
  "inviterId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "expenseGroupInvitation_status_check_d85c7349" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."expenseParticipant" (
  "amountMinor" int8 NOT NULL,
  "expenseId" text NOT NULL,
  "groupId" text NOT NULL,
  "memberId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("expenseId", "memberId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."externalIdentity" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "providerUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."member" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endedAt" timestamptz,
  "groupId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "identityId" text NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'INVITED' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "member_status_check_978abec9" CHECK ("status" IN ('INVITED', 'ACTIVE', 'LEFT', 'DECLINED', 'EXPIRED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."oAuthTransaction" (
  "browserBindingHash" text NOT NULL,
  "codeVerifier" text NOT NULL,
  "consumedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "purpose" text NOT NULL,
  "stateHash" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."outboxEvent" (
  "aggregateId" text NOT NULL,
  "aggregateType" text NOT NULL,
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastError" text,
  "leaseOwner" text,
  "leaseUntil" timestamptz,
  "nextAttemptAt" timestamptz,
  "occurredAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "payload" json NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "outboxEvent_status_check_a1492ded" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSED', 'DEAD_LETTER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."refreshToken" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "familyId" text NOT NULL,
  "generation" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "parentId" text,
  "replacedById" text,
  "revoked" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "revokedReason" text,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "refreshToken_revokedReason_check_9e2303fc" CHECK ("revokedReason" IN ('ROTATED', 'LOGOUT', 'REUSE_DETECTED', 'PASSWORD_CHANGED', 'SECURITY_EVENT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."refreshTokenFamily" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "revokedReason" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "refreshTokenFamily_revokedReason_check_9e2303fc" CHECK ("revokedReason" IN ('ROTATED', 'LOGOUT', 'REUSE_DETECTED', 'PASSWORD_CHANGED', 'SECURITY_EVENT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerifiedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "passwordHash" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
